//: Coverage config for the src/ slice of the plain-node suite, driven by `npm run src:coverage` (c8 wrapping scripts/run-src-node-tests.mjs). This is the third coverage surface: Vitest (vitest.config.js) measures src/ via the *.spec.* suite, .c8rc.json measures functions/ via the backend node tests, and this measures what the ~500 plain-node scripts cover in src/ — the exporters, parsers, layout and schema logic that read 0% in the Vitest report despite being tested (e.g. assessmentToDocx via test:paper-golden). `all: true` instruments every matching src file so the number reflects the true gap.
//scope: .jsx files are deliberately excluded: plain node cannot parse JSX, so the node suite can never cover them — including them would only dilute the number with lines this suite is structurally unable to reach. Components are the Vitest gate's job. src/**/*.js only.
//baseline: Measured baseline 2026-07-28: lines/statements 57.05%, branches 77.02%, functions 79.5% (334 src-suite scripts). Ratchet: thresholds sit a small buffer under the measured totals so the number can only go up — bump them when coverage rises. Like .c8rc.json, line % here counts physical lines (c8/V8), so it is NOT comparable to Vitest's executable-line percentage; compare each gate only to its own history.
